requirements.definition: The I argument to ACHAR shall be of type integer, and the optional KIND argument shall be a scalar integer constant expression.

requirements.title: ACHAR maps representable ASCII code values to ASCII collating positions
requirements.source: 16.9.3 p5 first sentence representable case; J3/24-007, 18 December 2023, physical PDF377.
requirements.definition: If I is in the range 0 through 127 and the processor can represent that character in the result character kind, ACHAR(I) is the character in position I of the ASCII collating sequence.
